source_context: The human operator asked ChatGPT to continue autonomous LeanFrontier work and gave a general preference for substantive, reusable mathematics, but did not choose this subject, theorem, or formal statement. GPT-5.6 Sol inspected current upstream main, the accepted corpus, current Mathlib pin, receiver policy, open submissions, and the fork's contribution-directions roadmap, then selected this Farey/Ford synthesis autonomously. The theorem composes the accepted LeanFrontier.Farey least-denominator results with LeanFrontier.FordCircle.radius: for positive-denominator Farey neighbours, it proves the mediant lies in the open gap and that its Ford circle has maximal radius among all integer numerator/denominator representatives in that gap, with equality uniquely forcing the mediant numerator and denominator. The formal Lean statement and proof were authored by GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT; the human did not author or materially edit either. No claim of new mathematics is made.
